name: OSS_ASSET_TXN_WORKERS_T
description: Folowing table is used to capture worker information of Installed base Asset ess job.

columns.name: WORKER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier to capture worker id of Installed base asset ess job

columns.name: WORKER_SEQ_NUMBER
columns.description: Field used to capture worker sequence number

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture batch id in customer asset update ess job

columns.name: BATCH_TYPE
columns.description: Field used to capture type of batch in customer asset update ess job

columns.name: BATCH_SEQ_NUMBER
columns.description: Field used to capture batch sequence number

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: MIN_TXN_SEQ_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture minimum transaction sequence id

columns.name: MAX_TXN_SEQ_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture maximum transaction sequence id

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Field used to capture status of worker in customer asset update ess job

columns.name: START_TIME
columns.description: Field used to capture start time of worker in customer asset update ess job

columns.name: END_TIME
columns.description: Field used to capture end time of worker in customer asset update ess job

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
